summary.text: Amy Brooks is a Democratic candidate for the Maryland House of Delegates, District 13, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She topped the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary for the district's three seats.

paragraphs.text: Amy Brooks also ran for the District 13 House of Delegates seat in 2022, when she was defeated in the Democratic primary.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a community leader, advocate and educator who had taught in middle schools and high schools across the state for over two decades.
She listed education funding, a higher statewide minimum wage, reproductive justice, housing and holding industrial polluters accountable among her policy priorities.
